title: 🏛️ Exams 2008–2026 · weather words, seasons and will ⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — language, exercise 1)
Last Sunday, Sophie and her family went to the park. Which word fits the blank? "The sun was shining and the air was ___ ."
questions.explanation: The blank describes the air, so it needs an adjective that says how it feels on a day when the sun is shining: warm. The noun sun names the thing in the sky and not the air, much tells an amount and does not describe the air, and sliding names an action and not a feeling.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025 — language, exercise 3)
The exam gives: "It's a lovely spring day. The sky is clear." Write the opposite of "clear" to complete the second paragraph: "It's a cool autumn day. The sky is ___ ."
questions.explanation: The opposite of a clear sky is a sky full of clouds, and the adjective is the noun plus a y: cloudy. The noun cloud cannot describe the sky, sunny says that the sun is out, which is close to clear and not its opposite, and snowing is an action and not a description of the sky.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — language, exercise 2)
Tomorrow is my sister's birthday. Which form fits the blank? "We ___ a big party."
questions.explanation: Tomorrow is after today, so the sentence takes will, and after will the verb stays bare: We will have a big party. After will the verb never takes -ing and no to comes between the two words, and had is a past form that cannot go with tomorrow.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — language, exercise 3)
The exam gives: "Kids enjoy playing outside." Write the opposite of "outside" to complete the sentence: "Kids enjoy playing ___ ."
questions.explanation: The opposite of outside is inside: the children play in the house and not in the yard. Outside is the word the question already gives, and beside and above are other words of place that do not mean the opposite.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2010 — language, exercise 1)
Today is a holiday and it is eleven o'clock in the morning. Choose the word that completes the sentence: "The weather is ___ , and the children are swimming."
questions.explanation: The weather needs an adjective built from the noun that names it: sun, with a doubled n, gives sunny, and swimming children fit a day with sun. Funny only looks like sunny: it means amusing and says nothing about the sky. The nouns sun and snow name things, so they cannot follow The weather is.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2010 — language, exercise 2)
Which word fits the gap? "The children are swimming in the ___ ."
questions.explanation: You swim in the water of the sea. The beach is the place beside the water where you walk and play, the sand is what the beach is made of, and a sandcastle is something you build, so none of the three is a place to swim.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2019 — language, exercise 2)
Complete the sentence with the opposite of "cold": "Can you open the window, please? It's very ___ ."
questions.explanation: Cold and hot are opposites, and a very hot room is a good reason to open the window. Cool is also a weather word, but it stays on the cold side, snowy describes a day with snow, and sun is a noun that cannot follow very.

questions.prompt:
(Exams 2018 and 2008 — writing)
It is winter in Manchester, and a picture shows a cloud with rain falling from it. The sentence says: "The weather is usually cold and ___ ." The five letters of the missing word are: a y r i n.

Type the missing word.
questions.explanation: Put the five letters in order to write the adjective that describes a day when water falls from the clouds. It is built like cloudy and windy: the noun of the thing that falls from the sky, plus a y. No other word can be made with the same five letters.
